name: ANSI/IEEE potentiometer symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for potentiometer, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The mobile-contact resistor form identifies a wiper associated with a resistive element. Its two end terminals and movable contact define the circuit connection, making the wiper path important when reading setpoint or feedback wiring.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Trace the wiper independently from the fixed ends.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A three-terminal divider connection and a two-terminal variable-resistance connection use the component differently.
